method: Real empty-project UI, numeric room authoring, actual shared-wall list, attached door/window editors, explicit complete-scope adoption, fixed mask and private note, full save/reload/ZIP/4K. Exact actual bitmap hashes/metadata, license texts and subject bindings compare with the blank-project baseline. No document injection. This covers architectural SCN-01, not all specified furnishings or full pathfinding.
